# 2. Define bins and assign them

# 3. Group by lot group and bin to calculate mean yield and count
g = df.groupby(['로트군', 'bin']).agg(
    mean_yield=('CNT수율 (g/g-cat)', 'mean'), 
    n=('런ID', 'count')
).reset_index()

# 4. Filter out bins with n < 10
g = g[g['n'] >= 10]

# 5. Calculate bin midpoints
g['bin_mid'] = g['bin'].apply(lambda x: (x.left + x.right) / 2)

# 6. Update df for plotting
